Install · proof receipt · 90 seconds

Run Sverklo proof on a real repo

Requires Node 24 or newer. MIT, no API keys, no code upload. First run downloads the local ONNX embedding model; after that indexing, search, audit, and memories stay on your machine.

npm install -g sverklo
sverklo init      # in your project root
sverklo prove     # see repo memory work on your code
sverklo prove --markdown  # share the proof

That's it. sverklo init auto-detects Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Antigravity, OpenAI Codex CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI — whichever you have installed gets the right MCP config written automatically. sverklo prove --markdown prints central files, one real caller graph, and a prompt to paste into your agent. Share the receipt in the proof thread, or share the part it gets wrong.

If sverklo doctor finds anything broken, it tells you exactly what to fix. Open an issue if it doesn't.
